name: Colour Coded
hint: A floor in your colour is not a floor for you. Fall in!
why4: Each well is capped by one colour and holds the button for one of the four gates in a row before the door; only player n can drop into well n.
solution: P1 walks onto the coral floor at x=8-10 and falls through into the well; walks right to touch the button at x=10 (gate A at x=29 opens); jumps up-left out of the well onto the floor at x=7.
P2 does the same in the sky-blue well at x=13-15 (button x=15 opens gate E at x=31).
P3 drops into the mint well at x=18-20, touches the key at x=19 (carries it) and the button at x=20 (gate F at x=33 opens), jumps out to the left.
P4 drops into the gold well at x=23-25, touches the button at x=25 (gate G at x=35 opens), jumps out to the left.
Everyone walks right through the four open gates; P3 opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
Note: the buttons are toggles; touching one a second time closes its gate again, so touch it once more to reopen.
